binance.limitation: REST snapshot only; displayed orders are not executions or institutional buying. Incremental analysis unavailable in phase 1.

coinbase.limitation: REST snapshot only; displayed orders are not executions or institutional buying. Incremental analysis unavailable in phase 1.

okx.usage: separate context; never replaces Binance observations or completes its score dimension

oi.amount_conversion: none; oiUsd is OKX-reported USD, not added to USDT

flow.timestamp_basis: bar opening timestamp; exclude current/unclosed bar
flow.cvd_definition: window taker buy BTC minus taker sell BTC; no conversion to quote notional

raw_archive.storage: Actions artifact lfm32-source-<run_id>, 30 days retention; local file when run locally
raw_archive.raw_format: normalized lossless trade fields, boundary trades, original derivatives responses, request audit

limitations: REST snapshot book is not a continuous sequence-verified order book.
Binance aggregate groups are not individual fills or complete unique taker orders; large-group classification cannot prove a large single fill.
USD and USDT never added; native quote thresholds do not assert FX parity.
Phase 1 has no liquidation feed; heatmaps must carry their own source and observation time.
monitoring_scope: verified fresh 5m/15m/60m spot trade windows; optional book/derivatives coverage is reported separately

exchange_agreement.amount_aggregation: disabled; USDT and USD are not added

book_absorption.reason: REST snapshots cannot verify absorption, cancellations, disappearing liquidity or iceberg orders; phase 2 required

analysis.calibration: initial heuristic weights; NOT institutional-entry probability. No historical backtest or out-of-sample validation yet. Missing dimensions never receive zero or rescaled 100-point conclusions.

spot_only_evidence.name: experimental_per_venue_spot_buy_evidence

all_taker_flow.reason: 15m taker buy / (buy + sell), native quote amounts within this venue

relative_large_records.reason: 15m buy share of feed records above this venue's same-window 60m empirical quantile; record granularity differs across venues

price_volume.reason: 15m price direction with last5m BTC volume vs previous two 5m bars; inconclusive=0.5

spot_only_evidence.scope: spot flow only; no OI, funding, passive absorption or liquidation evidence
spot_only_evidence.calibration: 50/25/25 explicit spot-only rubric; not a rescaling of the full score. No backtest or out-of-sample validation. Dynamic record sizes and count granularity differ across exchanges.
